SELECT * FROM EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER
TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER
SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATE), CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE))

SELECT CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) - CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATE)


EXECUTE [OM].[SP_SRC_CHECK] 'TSK_EDS_CCD_CUSTOMER','2026-05-26'


SELECT
	--	(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	*
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = '2026-05-26'
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER('TSK_EDS_CCD_CUSTOMER')
		AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
